thesis: Space is available. The constraint is the right product — lab, power, and adjacency — not a missing building count.

products.name: Lab-ready
products.line: Warm shell and spec lab still clear. Commodity office does not become science by renaming the floor plate.

products.name: Power on the clock
products.line: Usable megawatts on the tenant’s delivery date — not a utility story in 36 months.

products.name: Adjacency
products.line: Talent, campus, and existing operations. The Peninsula pays for being next to the work, not next to a highway shield.
